column1: # flow_point_decisions v1.0.0 -- finishes later than the commit that first recorded the item Done, in archived history that cannot be corrected (G193).

# Columns: register stem, item, first recorded Done (UTC), finish recorded (UTC), gap in hours, commit, reason. A row explains an item only while all three measured values equal it; a row that explains nothing fails; a new item is never excused.

# Reason (measured 2026-11-03 from git history with full depth): the item was committed Done at the time shown and the register carries a finish time later than that commit, the fault described in ROOT_CAUSE_ANALYSIS_an_item_registered_at_completion_with_its_times_typed_afterwards. The archived records are history and are not edited (append, never edit). An earlier measurement of this register (the same document, 2026-10-14) found 0; why the count differs now was not established here.
